title: Chidi learns about Germany's Opportunity Card
caption: Germany's Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) lets skilled people look for a job in Germany for up to 1 year 🇩🇪 Recognised qualification OR enough points, plus proof you can support yourself. Check the official Make it in Germany site! #germany #chancenkarte #workabroad #visa

scenes.backdrop: European city street at evening with old buildings, trams and warm lights

beats.title: MOVE TO GERMANY WITHOUT A JOB?

beats.text: Quddus, I heard Germany lets people come without a job offer. Is that a rumour from my uncle's WhatsApp group?
beats.say: Kuddus, I heard Germany lets people come without a job offer. Is that a rumour from my uncle's WhatsApp group?
This one is real. It's called the Opportunity Card, or Chancenkarte. It's a residence permit to look for a job in Germany.
A whole year to find a job?
Up to twelve months. But it can't be extended, so you need to use that time well.

scenes.backdrop: modern office with a world map, plants and a laptop

beats.say: Either your degree or vocational qualification is fully recognised in Germany, or you collect enough points from things like education, work experience, language, and age.
You must show you can support yourself while you search, for example with a blocked account. Check the exact amount on the official Make it in Germany site.
Guten Tag, Germany! I'm doing my research first!

scenes.backdrop: abstract glowing world map with flight paths, deep blue and gold, cinematic
